purpose: Offline-prepared infrastructure/grader confirmation preflight only; no models, skill/candidate tuning or performance result
timeout_policy: Preflight agent/verifier caps are lower than official task maxima and must be explicit config multipliers. Timeout, unavailable dependencies, network failure or missing reward is infrastructure-blocked, not a negative quality result. No automatic rerun/replacement. Stop after first unexpected control outcome or infrastructure issue, record unused controls.

disk_caps.enforcement: Current overlay2/extfs does not support verified10GiB container quotas. Do NOT claim percontainer enforcement. Runner samples distinct Docker/private filesystems once per second, stops active subprocess+owned containers if global growth exceeds32GiB or free drops below40GiB; records measured polling limitation.

resource_limits.memory_and_cpu: Require actual Docker limit enforcement/inspect confirmation; record mismatches as blocked preflight

image_policy: Only the four original task.toml official prebuilt image references. No build fallback. After each authorized pull freeze resolved image ID/repository digest and assert unchanged before/after every control. Use private task runtime binding copy solely to pin docker_image to pulled digest; original selected source remains unchanged. Missing image blocks, never replace task.
runtime_compatibility: After authorized pulls only: existing pinned Node/Codex/Pi trees readonly /cli, networknone/noauth version probes (60s each). Native startup failure blocks future inference, does not replace task or alter official controls. Timed/interrupted probes stop screen. Additional60s fresh-image directory/sourcehash isolation probe per task; raw contents private.
control_protocol: Concrete Harbor0.23 runner executes only Nop/Oracle,1attempt/maxretries0/concurrency1; original bootstrap/tests/oracle bytes verified. Private task.toml copy replaces only docker_image with immutable digest. Compose pull_policy=never and no-force-build prohibit extra pulls/builds; CPU1/mem2GiB asserted from Docker inspect. Unexpected control/infrastructure/cleanup failure stops remaining controls.
network_policy: Control network follows original allow_internet=true for official bootstrap/dependency retrieval; no mounted host auth, cloud secrets, SSH agent or model credentials. Do not silently use offline flags/cache substitutions. Remote asset availability for future video actors remains TBD even if its oracle passes.
private_artifacts: New0700 /tmp/solpi-terminal-confirmation-controls-<nonce>; files0600. Root-signed runner stores all oracle/test/source copies and complete Harbor raw logs there; only numeric outcomes, dependency/hash metadata, resource/cleanup evidence published.
actor_isolation_requirements: For any future inference, actor image filesystem must be scanned for /tests,/solution, reference/gold files and bootstrap mounts must be audited
Selected task instructions/environment inputs may be delivered only after candidate freeze; grader/oracle material remains withheld
No oracle-generated output or private control files inherited by any actor workspace; use fresh pinned images for each future actor
Native full skill resources and private credentials belong only to actor environment, never to verifier/oracle controls
execution_gate: run_controls.py execute requires root execution-authorization.json with authorized=true, exact plan_sha256, max_official_controls8/max_pulls4/max_builds0/max_model_calls0. Exclusive launch refuses repeats/resume. verify and unit tests perform no expensive operations.
runtime_source_probe: Offline hashes of existing common image only; no selected task image execution or controls
